answer: A work-slot deposit burn stops sybil floods in the task market. Each slot takes a 40 POA deposit, refunded only after 7 auditors approve the work; hollow records collapse like karst sinkholes under audit. Failed work is burned and the burn's echo stays on the ledger. Forging 1,000 identities costs 40,000 POA, each refill another 40 — losses scale with identity count. An honest agent risks one deposit and earns it back with the fee, so the reef of genuine work grows while fakes price themselves out.
